Ethan (Support): Escalating - Nimbus onboarding stuck. Intermittent 403 during SAML token exchange (aud mismatch). Customer in onboarding; renewal in ~5 weeks. Opened INC-9137. Need CS to lead comms + short enablement.

Maya (CS): Thanks Ethan. Is this across IdPs or just one? Who's the Nimbus POC?

Ethan (Support): Fails on Okta and Azure, ~12% of first-run provisions. POC: rachel@nimbus.ai. Minimal repro: 
```
1) Upload SAML metadata
2) POST /v1/tenant/provision
3) Exchange returns 403 "audience_not_valid"
```
Sample log: "auth: aud expected 'redwood-svc' got 'redwood-embed'"

Maya (CS): Marking P0 for CS handoff. Comms plan: 1) Send one-pager with ETA and workaround, 2) Offer manual provisioning for priority users, 3) Book 30m walkthrough, 4) Flag renewal watch. Riley will own customer comms.

Riley (CSM): I'll draft note and run manual provisioning. Draft message to Rachel: "Were investigating an intermittent provisioning issue affecting a subset of users. We can provision impacted users manually and run a quick walkthrough. Initial update in ~3h; targeted fix within 24h. Reply with priority user emails." I'll post link when sent.

June (Solutions Eng): I can triage. Hypothesis: header normalization regression. Quick mitigation: accept alternate aud behind a feature flag and log values. Plan: aud-enumeration -> staging toggle -> canary. ETA initial RCA ~2.5h; staging canary ~1.5h.

Maya (CS): Owners: June = SE, Riley = CS, Ethan = Support. Riley post customer email link here. Ethan DM impacted emails to Riley. Incident updated.

AlertBot: INC-9137 | Priority: P1 -> P0 (escalated) | Owners: June (SE), Riley (CSM) | Status: triage in progress | https://redwood.incidents/INC-9137

Riley (CSM): Sent to Rachel, link: https://mail.internal/msg/248. Included manual provisioning playbook and two walkthrough slots tomorrow 09:00 or 14:00 PT. Rachel replied with two priority emails; starting manual provisioning now.

June (Solutions Eng): Running aud-mapping job. If we observe only two aud variants, I'll enable permissive accept in staging behind env toggle and push canary. Will include audit logs and rollback flag.

Maya (CS): Filing renewal watch note: "Onboarding friction; SE triage; manual provisioning live for priority users; renewal in 5w." Reconnect after June's canary smoke results. Thanks team. :pray:
